description: This file defines the Theme class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet namespace, encapsulating theme-related properties such as color schemes, font settings, and substitutions for spreadsheet documents.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents a theme configuration for a spreadsheet, including color schemes, fonts, and substitutions.

methods.name: getThemeColors
methods.description: Returns the current theme color palette.

methods.name: setThemeColor
methods.description: Sets a specific color in the theme's color palette by key.

methods.name: getThemeColorName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current theme color scheme.

methods.name: setThemeColorName
methods.description: Sets the theme color scheme by name, optionally updating the color palette.

methods.name: getMajorFontLatin
methods.description: Returns the Latin font used as the major font.

methods.name: getMajorFontEastAsian
methods.description: Returns the East Asian font used as the major font.

methods.name: getMajorFontComplexScript
methods.description: Returns the Complex Script font used as the major font.

methods.name: getMajorFontSubstitutions
methods.description: Returns the font substitutions for the major fonts.

methods.name: setMajorFontValues
methods.description: Sets the major font values and substitutions.

methods.name: getMinorFontLatin
methods.description: Returns the Latin font used as the minor (body) font.

methods.name: getMinorFontEastAsian
methods.description: Returns the East Asian font for the minor font.

methods.name: getMinorFontComplexScript
methods.description: Returns the Complex Script font for the minor font.

methods.name: getMinorFontSubstitutions
methods.description: Returns the font substitutions for the minor fonts.

methods.name: setMinorFontValues
methods.description: Sets the minor font values and substitutions.
